evidence.value: Prices in Dec are usually -0.8% vs Oct (after removing the long trend)
evidence.source: Seasonal index from 9 years of prices (82% weight, rest = no season)
evidence.why: Indian demand peaks around Dhanteras, Diwali and the wedding season; world demand around Chinese New Year.

evidence.source: World price x Rs rate (Yahoo Finance)
evidence.why: Prices tend to keep moving the way they are moving for a few weeks.

evidence.value: Price Rs 1,33,480 vs 200-day avg Rs 1,45,057; 50-day avg Rs 1,41,758
evidence.test: price and 50-day both above the 200-day: +1 | both below: -1
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last ~9 months
evidence.why: Metals move in long waves; going with the big trend avoids fighting it.

evidence.value: Today is higher than 25% of the last year's days (range Rs 1,19,270 - Rs 1,66,151)
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last 365 days
evidence.why: Buying in the cheap part of the yearly range limits risk.

evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last 14 trading days

forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 5.7% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-4.2%).
forecast_reason.telugu: 30 రోజుల్లో సుమారు 5.7% తగ్గవచ్చు. ప్రధాన కారణం: ఇటీవలి ధోరణి (-4.2%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 6.3% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 1.6% lower in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is below the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day dip only half, so it starts 0.1% higher than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -12.5% to +3.1% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 5.2% on average at 30 days, vs 5.3% for "price stays the same" - it adds a little value. Direction right 69% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.
